mapper.select: -- READ COMMITTED 변경 transaction에서 같은 분할 예약 요청을 직렬화한다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),75001))::text
-- source/policy 이후에만 전체 목록을 잠근다. 일반 조회는 잠금이 없다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_runs WHERE id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
-- 고정 분할 하나만 잠그고 삭제 카운터와 잔여 실제 목록을 대조한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_segments s WHERE s.run_id=#{runId} AND s.segment_no=#{segmentNo} FOR UPDATE OF s

-- DB에서1~1000건으로 고정된 한 분할 전체. 원래 범위 조건이나 LIMIT를 반복하지 않는다. SELECT ordinal,source_id,content_version_id,base_evaluation_id,rule_release_id,provider_code,input_hash, coalesce(input_hash=attachment_backfill_input_hash(source_id),false) AS current_input_matches FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_items WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND segment_no=#{segmentNo} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.sql: l.run_id,l.segment_no,l.batch_id,l.deleted_before_reservation,l.expected_run_version,l.segment_hash, l.requested_by,l.idempotency_key,l.request_hash,s.item_count AS original_item_count,b.scope_item_count AS reserved_item_count, b.batch_status_code AS current_batch_status_code,l.created_at

announcement_attachment_backfill_segment_batches l JOIN announcement_attachment_backfill_segments s ON s.run_id=l.run_id AND s.segment_no=l.segment_no JOIN announcement_attachment_batches b ON b.id=l.batch_id
mapper.select: -- 실패·취소·원복된 배치 연결도 보존하며 다른 배치로 바꾸지 않는다. SELECT FROM WHERE l.run_id=#{runId} AND l.segment_no=#{segmentNo}
-- 현재 원문/정책이 달라져도 최초 요청 영수증의 동일 입력 재조회는 가능하다. SELECT FROM WHERE l.idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: -- 고정 대상의 SCOPE_READY job 예약과 같은 transaction에서 일대일 연결한다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_backfill_segment_batches(run_id,segment_no,batch_id,deleted_before_reservation,expected_run_version, segment_hash,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) VALUES (#{runId},#{segmentNo},#{batchId},#{deletedBeforeReservation},#{expectedRunVersion},#{segmentHash},#{requestedBy},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash})
mapper.sql: SELECT i.source_id,l.batch_id,j.id AS job_id,j.job_status_code,j.application_status_code,j.rollback_status_code, CASE WHEN l.batch_id IS NULL THEN coalesce(i.input_hash=attachment_backfill_input_hash(i.source_id),false) ELSE true END AS input_matches FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_items i LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_backfill_segment_batches l ON l.run_id=i.run_id AND l.segment_no=i.segment_no LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.batch_id=l.batch_id AND j.source_id=i.source_id AND j.content_version_id=i.content_version_id AND j.base_evaluation_id=i.base_evaluation_id AND j.rule_release_id=i.rule_release_id WHERE i.run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: -- 전체 잔여 item을 집계한다. 삭제·미예약·job 누락을 성공으로 바꾸지 않는다. WITH current_items AS MATERIALIZED () SELECT count(1) AS remaining_item_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_backfill_segment_batches WHERE run_id=#{runId}) AS reserved_segment_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL) AS reserved_remaining_item_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE batch_id IS NULL) AS unreserved_item_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE batch_id IS NULL AND NOT input_matches) AS unreserved_input_changed_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id IS NULL) AS missing_job_count FROM current_items

-- 세 차원의 분모는 각각 전체 잔여 수다. APPLIED 이력을 ROLLED_BACK과 합산해 이중 성공으로 세지 않는다. WITH current_items AS MATERIALIZED () SELECT d.dimension_code,CASE WHEN c.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'UNRESERVED' WHEN c.job_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_JOB' ELSE d.status_code END AS status_code, count(1) AS item_count FROM current_items c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('COLLECTION',c.job_status_code),('APPLICATION',c.application_status_code),('ROLLBACK',c.rollback_status_code)) d(dimension_code,status_code) GROUP BY d.dimension_code,CASE WHEN c.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'UNRESERVED' WHEN c.job_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_JOB' ELSE d.status_code END ORDER BY d.dimension_code,status_code
